tail:
The correction is complete and validated. Summary of what I found and did:

- The top-level `batch` field was already the bare id `"1"`; I kept it.
- All 32 prior findings named in-flight items whose complete pre/post snapshot fingerprints changed (`item_sha256` and `contract_sha256` differ for every one; the two renamed carriers plus all four pages also differ). Per the routing rule, a carrier whose complete fingerprint changed is already routed mechanically and cannot remain an open finding, so all 32 were removed, leaving an empty `findings` array.
- The existing reader report `research/frontier-31a-reader-1.md` was left untouched, preserving the documented defects; the `coverage_note` now states this correction.
- Simulated the plan-gate check: batch label passes, no bad carriers, no changed carriers — the artifact is no longer malformed.
